text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno is making her move!
Charging up the slope! Surging ahead with incredible force!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Since the Satsuki Sho,
Fenomeno's running has developed even further."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's not just that she's stopped overthinking, but rather... her drive and presence have intensified.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't tell whether Gold Ship
created this situation on purpose or not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet no matter how discouraged a champion of justice
might become, they can always reignite the fire in their
heart for the sake of justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I...!
In the Derby, the stage of an Umamusume's dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I will definitely catch Gold Ship-san!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oho... Rather than saying 'I want to win the Derby,' she brings up her rival's name first, huh...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Gold Ship is the overwhelming favorite
for the Derby right now, right?
To "catch" her, you'd have to...

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
The wild and unpredictable one, and the earnest, serious one...
They truly are polar opposites, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should make this the main event of the special broadcast♪
